blocks.text: Dermo Peel Facial – Liquid Microneedling for Radiant, Youthful Skin
blocks.html: Dermo Peel Facial – Liquid Microneedling for Radiant, Youthful Skin

Experience deep skin renewal with the Dermo Peel Facial – an advanced skin resurfacing treatment designed to refine skin texture, target signs of ageing, deep wrinkles and sun damage to reveal a brighter, smoother complexion.

The Dermo Peel is a next-generation exfoliating facial that combines the effects of microdermabrasion and a gentle chemical peel. It features a exclusive blend of phytoplankton spicules, alpha hydroxy acids (AHAs), and beta hydroxy acids (BHAs) to dramatically improve skin tone, texture, and luminosity. Also known as Liquid Microneedling or Bio Microneedling, as it gently creates micro-channels in the skin, which encourages cell renewal, stimulates collagen production, and helps with the absorption of active ingredients, without using actual needles.
Spicules come in different shapes

blocks.text: What are Spicules and how are they used in facials?
blocks.html: What are Spicules and how are they used in facials?

Spicules are microscopic (not visible to the naked eye), needle-like structures, often derived from marine sponges, plankton or plants. By applying spicules to the skin, they help create micro-channels (very tiny punctures) in the skin, which allows the skin to absorb active ingredients better, and also encourages cell turnover and stimulates collagen production.

The Dermo Peel Facial uses phytoplankton crystals to create the smallest spicules in the world, featuring unique rounded edges to prevent skin damage, ensuring a gentle and effective exfoliation. You may notice a prickly, tingling sensation during and after the facial — this is completely normal and a clear sign that the spicules are working beneath the surface, stimulating renewal and absorption at a cellular level.

Frequently Ask Question

Is there any downtime after the treatment?

There may be mild redness or peeling after the treatment, but this varies from person to person. Most clients can resume their daily activities immediately.

Can I combine Dermo Peel Facial with other treatments?

Yes, but it is best to consult with a skincare professional to determine the best combination for your skin type and concerns.

Are there any side effects?

Common side effects may include mild redness, tingling, or peeling, which should subside within a few days.

What should I do after the Dermo Peel Treatment?

✅ Avoid Touching Your Skin
The micro-crystals continue working for 48+ hours. Avoid touching or rubbing your skin.

✅ Avoid Heat & Sweat
Avoid activities that cause flushing or overheating, such as exercise, steam baths, and saunas.

✅ Strict Sun Protection
Completely avoid sun exposure and apply SPF 30-50 daily to prevent hyperpigmentation.
